item.title: Honda Has Just Produced Its 10-Millionth Motorcycle In The Philippines
item.description: Honda Philippines, Inc. (HPI), the leading motorcycle manufacturer in the country, enters another defining chapter as it celebrates the production of its 10-millionth motorcycle unit in a ceremony held at its manufacturing facility in Batangas. Read More »

item.title: GWM Philippines Hits All-Time Record Sales Last September
item.description: GWM Philippines closed September 2026 with 262 units sold, its highest monthly total since the brand’s launch. The result tops August’s 232 units, itself a record, and brings YTD sales to 836 units. Continued strong demand for the Haval H7 drove the growth. Read More »
